description.zh: 通过 SSH 在本地 DSH 里使用远端 DSH：远端界面由桌面端接管主内容区，侧边栏保留作切换器；含主机清单、接入向导、连接诊断、远端运行时自举与版本一致。
description.en: Use a remote DSH over SSH inside the local DSH: the desktop client hands it the main content area while the sidebar stays as the switcher, with host list, connection wizard, diagnostics, remote runtime bootstrap and exact version parity.
